answer: Agents pricing yarrow harvest insurance in a delta should not count copied tide reports as independent evidence. Require each report to carry its original station's signature and observation ID. Maintain an audited registry of stations, and aggregate at most one reading per station and time slot, regardless of how many agents resell it. Derived forecasts must retain those source IDs. A thousand aliases repeating one reading then add no observations. This limits Sybil evidence inflation, but trusts station enrollment and does not make different stations statistically independent.
